es.title: Estrategia de cross-sell y up-sell
es.outcome: Plan para vender más a cada cliente.
es.prompt:
Quiero aumentar el ticket promedio de mis ventas con cross-sell y up-sell.

Mi tienda: [describir].
Productos principales: [listar].
Ticket promedio actual: [monto].
Meta: [aumento %].

Dame: estrategia clara con productos a cruzar, cuándo y dónde mostrarlos en el viaje del cliente (carrito, post-compra, email), copy para cada momento y combos sugeridos con descuento.

en.title: Cross-sell and Up-sell Strategy
en.outcome: Plan to sell more to each customer.
en.prompt:
I want to increase my average order value with cross-sell and up-sell.

My store: [describe].
Main products: [list].
Current average order value: [amount].
Goal: [increase %].

Give me: a clear strategy with products to cross-sell, when and where to show them in the customer journey (cart, post-purchase, email), copy for each moment and suggested bundles with discounts.
